module.title: Module 9: Places In Town And Directions

words.example: The bank is near the hotel.
I buy food at the supermarket.
The bakery is next to the bank.
I watch movies at the cinema.
The cafe is next to the park.
I send a letter at the post office.
The mall is across from the park.
I go to school by bus.
I wait at the bus stop.
The boat is on the water.
The park is across from the mall.
The store is on the corner.
The cafe is next to the park.
The cafe is between the bank and school.

grammar.title: Imperatives (Giving Directions)
grammar.explanation:
Buyruq shakli buyruq yoki yoʻl koʻrsatish uchun ishlatiladi — asosiy fe’l bilan boshlanadi (egasiz):

- **Go** straight. — Toʻgʻri boring.
- **Turn** left / right. — Chapga / oʻngga buriling.
- **Stop** here. — Shu yerda toʻxtang.

Inkor: **Don’t** + fe’l → **Don’t go!** (Bormang!).

Oʻzbek tilida ham buyruq egasiz («Boring», «Buriling», «Bormang»), lekin hurmat qoʻshimchasi (-ing) bor; inglizchada fe’l oʻzgarmaydi, inkor esa Don’t bilan quriladi.

exercises.explanation: Toʻgʻri tartib: Turn + left + at + the corner.

lines.speaker: Local Person
lines.text: Yes. It is next to the bank.

comps.title: Directions Builder
comps.passage: Excuse me, where is the hospital? Go straight. Then turn left at the corner. The hospital is next to the post office. The bank is near the park. It is not far. Walk for five minutes. If you want the museum, take the bus at the bus stop.
comps.passageTranslated: Kechirasiz, kasalxona qayerda? Toʻgʻri boring. Keyin burchakda chapga buriling. Kasalxona pochta yonida. Bank park yaqinida. U uzoq emas. Besh daqiqa yuring. Agar muzey kerak boʻlsa, bekatdan avtobusga oʻtiring.

questions.question: Where is the hospital?
questions.explanation: Matn: The hospital is next to the post office.

questions.question: What is near the park?
questions.explanation: Matn: The bank is near the park.

questions.question: How do you get to the museum?

comps.title: Listening: Finding the Way
comps.passage: Excuse me, where is the bank? Go straight on. Then turn left. The bank is next to the shop. It is near the park. It is not far. Thank you very much. The hospital is across from the park. If you want the museum, take the bus at the bus stop near the corner.
comps.passageTranslated: Kechirasiz, bank qayerda? Toʻgʻri yuring. Keyin chapga buriling. Bank doʻkon yonida. U park yaqinida. U uzoq emas. Katta rahmat. Kasalxona park qarshisida. Agar muzey kerak boʻlsa, burchak yaqinidagi bekatdan avtobusga oʻtiring.

questions.question: What place is he looking for?
What is the bank next to?
questions.explanation: Matn: The bank is next to the shop.

comps.title: Asking for Directions
comps.passage: Let's review directions! I walk to the city. I look for the museum. I go straight and turn right. It is between the cafe and the library.
comps.passageTranslated: Keling, yoʻnalishlarni takrorlaymiz! Men shaharga piyoda ketyapman. Muzeyni qidiryapman. Toʻgʻri boraman va oʻngga buraman. U kafe va kutubxona orasida.

questions.question: What am I looking for?
questions.explanation: Matn: I look for the museum.

questions.question: Where is it?
questions.explanation: Matn: It is between the cafe and the library.

comps.title: Where Is the Pharmacy?
comps.passage: Excuse me, where is the pharmacy? Go straight and turn left at the traffic light. The pharmacy is next to the bank. It is not far. Walk for five minutes. The hospital is across from the park. If you want the museum, take the bus at the bus stop near the corner.
comps.passageTranslated: Kechirasiz, dorixona qayerda? Toʻgʻri boring va svetoforda chapga buriling. Dorixona bank yonida. U uzoq emas. Besh daqiqa yuring. Kasalxona park qarshisida. Agar muzey kerak boʻlsa, burchak yaqinidagi bekatdan avtobusga oʻtiring.

questions.question: Where do you turn left?
questions.explanation: Matn: Go straight and turn left at the traffic light.

questions.question: What is next to the bank?
questions.explanation: Matn: The pharmacy is next to the bank.

questions.question: How do you get to the museum?
questions.explanation: Matn: If you want the museum, take the bus at the bus stop near the corner.

questions.question: Translate 'Kasalxona qayerda?':
questions.explanation: Kasalxona qayerda? = Where is the hospital?

questions.questionTranslated: Toʻgʻrisini tanlang: ___ right at the corner.

questions.explanation: Jamoat transportida borish → go by bus (drive = oʻzing haydash).
